listing.title: Water Hyacinth Rectangular Placemats (Set of 2)
listing.body_text:
Set of 2 placemats handcrafted out of Water Hyacinth. Its natural tone and texture will add a touch of warmth and rustic charm to your home and dining space. Comes with a coating of clear lacquer for easy maintenance. DHARINI products are handcrafted from eco-friendly and sustainable Natural Fibres. We bring together the incredible skills of artisans and master craftspeople from the remotest corners of the country, who have inherited and perfected their art over generations.
Care & Cleaning: Use dry soft cloth to clean this product. Avoid direct contact with water.
Note: Each piece is handcrafted using natural fibres, slight variations may occur in colour and size.
Features: Rectangular
Material: Water Hyacinth
Colour: Natural
Size: Length-18inch, Breadth-12inch
Usage: Home/Gifting
Set Content: 2 Placemats
Weight: 300 gm (approx.)
Disclaimer: Colour discrepancies may occur between this product and your computer screen.
